command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmds=@('display interface Ethernet1/0/1','display interface Ethernet1/0/2','display isis interface verbose','display isis interface','display mpls ldp lsp'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in `$cmds){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get; if(`$r.output -notlike 'Error:*'){Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' :: '+`$c+' ==='); Write-Output `$r.output}}}"
